title: Why every company is building their own AI model in 2026

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: Why is every company rushing to build their own AI model in 2026? What's driving this shift?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Advances in transformer architectures and access to specialized chips make custom AI models more feasible and cost-effective than ever before.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But this trend risks creating fragmented AI ecosystems, reducing interoperability and increasing the potential for biased, unregulated systems.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Engineers are prioritizing modular design and open standards to ensure models can collaborate and share knowledge across industries.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If done right, this could lead to a more diverse, adaptable AI landscape that better serves different cultural and economic contexts.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future may see a balance between specialization and collaboration, driven by both innovation and responsibility.

video_cue: A montage of diverse companies integrating AI into their workflows, with seamless data exchange between systems.
